title: Stable constant weighted mean curvature hypersurfaces in anti-Gaussian space
summary: We prove that in the anti-Gaussian space $\bigl(\R^{m+1},\bar g_{\Euc},e^{|x|^2/4}\,dx\bigr)$, $m\ge2$, round spheres centered at the origin are the only closed, connected, two-sided immersed hypersurfaces with constant weighted mean curvature that are stable under weighted-volume-preserving variations.
